The '''''Eternal Crusader''''' was a [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] in [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|the fleet]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. It was captured by the Tribe and placed under the command of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]]. Rhea's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Vestara Khai]], also served aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], the ship was chosen to carry a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] to find the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. After locating Ship on a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], the Sith discovered the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]]. As numerous [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] fell to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] deadly [[Plant/Legends|plants]], more and more Sith were ferried down from the ''Eternal Crusader'' in [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], until finally there were no Sith left aboard the warship. When the strike team finally recovered Ship, they took the Meditation Sphere to [[Sinkhole Station]]&mdash;a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that Skywalker was visiting&mdash;to complete their [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|mission]]. They failed, however, and Khai was the strike team's sole survivor; thus the ''Eternal Crusader'' was left in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Abeloth's world. Later, in [[44 ABY]], the Sith allied themselves with Skywalker for a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to destroy Abeloth. Upon their arrival at her world, they saw the ''Eternal Crusader'' still in orbit.
